content:
I've been frustrated watching job search tools either spam applications blindly or ask candidates to lie on resumes. So I built Aether differently.

It uses licensed API data (not scraped listings), scores job fit deterministically so you know *why* a role matches, and tailors your resume while actively preventing fabrications. Every application gets human approval before sending—because your reputation matters.

Gmail integration triages offers automatically. No noise, just signal.

Started with a free tier: 5 runs monthly, no credit card. Paid plans scale from $19–$69/month AUD depending on how many applications you want monthly oversight on.

This isn't a volume play. It's about matching *better*.

Try the free plan and see if it changes how you approach job search: https://5cb5f0620.abacusai.cloud

#JobSearch #CareerTech #Hiring
